# Norwood Supply

> Family-owned doors, millwork, and general building supply retailer in Jacksonville, Florida, serving Northeast Florida and Southeast Georgia since 1971. Specializes in in-stock and special-order residential doors and hard-to-find, discontinued, or odd-profile molding.

## Business

- Legal name: Surplus Plywood, Inc., DBA Norwood Supply
- Founded: 1971, family-owned
- Location: 6200 Norwood Ave, Jacksonville, FL 32208
- Phone: (904) 768-6818
- Text (photos welcome): (904) 403-5261
- Hours: Monday-Friday 7:30am-5:00pm, Saturday 8:30am-12:00pm, closed Sunday
- Service area: Duval, Clay, St. Johns, Nassau, and Baker Counties, FL; delivery within about 75 miles of Jacksonville
- Serves: homeowners, remodel contractors, landlords, property managers, and businesses

## What we sell

- [In-Stock Door Inventory](https://www.norwoodsupply.com/catalog.html): over 1,000 doors in stock — exterior fiberglass prehung units and interior engineered shaker doors, both prehung and slab.
- Special-order doors: custom sizes, impact-rated units, solid wood, and hard-to-find residential doors sourced through major millwork distributors, typically 3-4 days for standard stock and longer for special orders.
- Special-order and odd-profile molding/millwork sourcing, including discontinued and hard-to-match profiles.
- General building supplies for retail, remodel, and industrial trade customers.
- Bulk pricing available on orders of 15+ doors; repeat-business pricing for property managers, landlords, and remodel contractors.

## Customer tools

- [Door Finder](https://www.norwoodsupply.com/door-finder.html): customers send a photo of their existing door or opening and get help identifying the right replacement spec.
- [Door Swing Checker](https://www.norwoodsupply.com/tools/door-swing.html): helps determine door handing (left/right, in/out swing) before ordering.
- [Measure Your Door](https://www.norwoodsupply.com/measure-your-door.html): guide for measuring a door or opening correctly before ordering.

## Frequently asked questions

Full answers are published at https://www.norwoodsupply.com/#faq and cover: available styles and sizes, prehung vs. slab, Florida Building Code approval status, delivery area and cost, installation (referral only, Norwood does not install), interior door construction, exterior door materials (99% fiberglass), warranty terms (1 year on new doors; clearance/scratch-and-dent sold as-is), impact-rated and 8-foot doors, bulk discounts, and how to place an order.
